HEARING ON PETITIONER TANEIKA JONES' REQUEST TO DISPENSE WITH NOTICE TO THE MINOR'S OTHER PARENT RE: PETITION FOR CHANGE OF NAME OF MINOR
Off Calendar Feb-01-2023 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This matter comes on calendar being set for Petitioner Taneika Jones' request to dispense with notice to the minor's other parent.

Dept. 505; Judge Michelle Tong; Clerk: Shanika Monroe; Proceedings recorded by "For the Record" commencing at 09:28:34 a.m. and concluding at 09:40:53 a.m.

Petitioner Taneika Jones appearing in pro per, is placed under oath, and testifies.

Petitioner submits photos of residence located at 20 Whitfield, San Francisco, CA, copy of Child Support Order filed Jun-13-2016, and confirms that a new family lives at 20 Whitfield.
Petitioner is examined by the Court re: attempts to locate Father, Steven Sebastian Easy.

The matter is submitted.
Based on Court's previous finding and judgment of parentage, Petitioner Taneika Jones' request to dispense with notice to the minor's other parent is GRANTED. Proposed order signed.

HEARING ON PETITIONER TANEIKA JONES' REQUEST TO DISPENSE WITH NOTICE TO THE MINOR'S OTHER PARENT RE: PETITION FOR MINOR'S NAME CHANGE
Off Calendar Dec-29-2022 Continued To Feb-01-23 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 505
MINI MINUTES: This matter comes on calendar being set for Petitioner's request to dispense with notice to the minor's other parent re: petition for change of name of minor.

Dept. 514; Judge Michelle Tong; Clerk: Shanika Monroe; Proceedings recorded by "For the Record" commencing at 09:28:50 a.m., pausing at 09:40:38 a.m., reconvening at 09:40:57 a.m., and concluding at 09:44:21 a.m.

Petitioner Taneika Jones appearing in pro per, is placed under oath, and testifies.

Proof of Publication filed Aug-31-2022.
Petitioner unable to serve the other parent, Steven Sebastian Easy and requests the Court waive its notice requirement to the other parent in this matter.

Court examines Petitioner regarding the following:

1. Current residence; Petitioner resides in San Francisco
2. Visits to the last known location of Steven Sebastian Easy at 20 Whitfield, San Francisco, CA
3. Attempts to contact any relatives of Steven Sebastian Easy
4. Additional attempts to contact Steven Sebastian Easy through Child Support Services and other agencies

Court orders matter continued to Feb-01-2023 at 9:00 a.m. in Department 514 for Petitioner to make further attempts to locate Steven Sebastian Easy. THE COURT ORDERS PETITIONER TO DO THE FOLLOWING IN PREPARATION FOR THE NEXT HEARING:

1. Petitioner shall conduct Google searches to locate Steven Sebastian Easy
2. Petitioner shall go to the location of 20 Whitfield, San Francisco, CA to see what is going on and if there is a forwarding address. Petitioner shall take a photo of said residence.
3. Petitioner shall bring documents identifying names of family members contacted in an attempt to locate Steven Sebastian Easy.
4. Petitioner shall bring papers from Child Support Services and other agencies confirming her search results.
5. Petitioner shall bring copies of DNA results for minor.
